title_zh: 黄仁勋辞职后首次发声：董事会认可的话，愿重返英伟达当 CEO
content_zh:
上下滑动查看更多内容

黄仁勋在社交平台发布长文，首次公开回应外界要求他重返英伟达的呼声。他表示，如果董事会认为他的回归符合股东、员工、公司以及美国的最佳利益，他愿意再次出任英伟达 CEO。

黄仁勋在声明中称，自己没有达到英伟达对每位员工的行为要求，在私人生活中犯下严重错误，也给董事会带来了问题。

他表示将承担全部责任，并配合董事会正在进行的独立调查。他还提到，离开英伟达后，来自员工、投资者、商业合作伙伴和客户的支持声音很多，不少人在英伟达面临复杂的技术、市场、竞争和地缘政治局势之际直接联系他。声明中，他没有要求董事会恢复职务，而是把决定权交给董事会。

不过，英伟达董事会主席哈维·琼斯在财报电话会议上表示，公司不打算让黄仁勋复职。

哈维·琼斯称，我们希望尽快任命正式首席执行官，但不会为了赶时间而仓促决定，必须先找到最合适的人选。

title_en: Jensen Huang Open to Returning as Nvidia CEO, But Board Signals No Intent to Reinstate
content_en:
In his first public statement since stepping down, Jensen Huang expressed a willingness to return as Nvidia's Chief Executive Officer if the board of directors deems his comeback to be in the best interest of shareholders, employees, the company, and the nation.

Huang acknowledged taking full responsibility for serious personal missteps that failed to meet Nvidia's conduct standards. While noting overwhelming support from employees, investors, and business partners during a complex transition period for Nvidia, he reiterated that any decision regarding his potential return rests entirely with the board.

However, Nvidia Board Chair Harvey Jones clarified during the company's recent earnings call that there are no plans to reinstate Huang. Jones stated that while Nvidia aims to appoint a permanent CEO as quickly as possible, the board will take the necessary time to select the right candidate.

title_zh: 英伟达季度营收首次突破千亿美元，数据中心收入增长 110%
content_zh:
英伟达公布截至 10 月 25 日的 2027 财年第三季度业绩，营收达 1158 亿美元，同比增长 103%、环比增长 20%，首次单季超过千亿美元。GAAP 净利润约 653 亿美元，同比增长 105%。

本季主要数据包括：

临时 CEO、执行副总裁兼 CFO 科莱特·克雷斯表示，Vera Rubin 的初期增长强劲，产品路线图按计划推进。公司称 Vera Rubin NVL72 已开始出货，并在 CoreWeave、Google Cloud、微软 Azure 等合作伙伴处运行。

英伟达预计第四季度营收为 1300 亿美元，上下浮动 3%。该季度比通常多一周，指引未计入来自中国的数据中心计算收入。
title_en: Nvidia Crosses $100B Quarterly Revenue Threshold with 103% Year-Over-Year Surge
content_en:
Nvidia reported landmark financial results for its third quarter of fiscal 2027, driven by relentless demand for AI hardware. Quarterly revenue surged 103% year-over-year to $115.8 billion—marking the first time the company has surpassed the $100 billion threshold in a single quarter. GAAP net profit reached approximately $65.3 billion, up 105% from the prior year.

Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress highlighted strong early momentum for the Vera Rubin architecture. Deliveries of the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform are already underway, with systems currently running across major cloud partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

Looking ahead, Nvidia issued a fourth-quarter revenue guidance of $130 billion (plus or minus 3%). The company noted that the upcoming quarter includes an extra operational week and excludes data center compute revenue from China.

title_zh: AMD 完成收购 World Labs，李飞飞出任执行副总裁兼首席科学家
content_zh:
AMD 11 月 16 日宣布，已完成对 AI 研究公司 World Labs 的收购。World Labs 创始人李飞飞加入 AMD，担任执行副总裁兼首席科学家，直接向 AMD 董事长兼 CEO 苏姿丰汇报。

World Labs 开发能够创建、模拟可交互 3D 环境的 AI 模型，同时研究机器人学习与仿真技术。收购后，团队将继续开展基础模型研究，并与 AMD 工程师合作，将新模型能力的研究成果用于未来 AI 基础设施的开发。

苏姿丰表示，为下一阶段的超级智能提供基础设施，需要同时优化计算平台与模型。AMD 希望借助 World Labs 团队的模型研究，参与下一代硬件、软件和系统的设计，服务开放 AI 生态中的客户与开发者。
title_en: AMD Completes Acquisition of World Labs; Fei-Fei Li Joins as Chief Scientist
content_en:
AMD has finalized its acquisition of World Labs, an AI research start-up specializing in foundation models that generate and simulate interactive 3D environments and robotics learning technologies.

With the closing of the deal, World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to Chair and CEO Lisa Su. The World Labs team will continue advancing fundamental AI model research while collaborating closely with AMD engineers to integrate these capabilities into future AI infrastructure.

AMD CEO Lisa Su emphasized that scaling the next phase of superintelligence requires the co-optimization of compute platforms and AI models, positioning World Labs' expertise as a core component of AMD's open AI ecosystem.

title_zh: 车企 60 天账期进入年度调研评估，故意拖延付款将被约谈
content_zh:
车企承诺的「60 天账期」将进入年度调研评估。中国汽车工业协会 11 月 16 日发布通知，受工信部委托，对 17 家重点汽车企业的供应商账款支付情况开展评估。

评估采取「车企定期报送＋样本供应商抽查」方式，每年从每家车企的供应商中随机抽取不少于 15 家，通过资料核查、现场调研等确认付款情况。车企须在每年 1 月 31 日前报送上年度报告、7 月 31 日前报送当年上半年报告。

核查内容包括中小企业账期是否超过 60 天、现金支付情况，以及非中小企业账期是否符合 60 天要求、现金和银行承兑汇票支付比例是否不低于 80%。评估结果报送工信部后，将按程序向社会公开。

据财联社报道，工信部相关负责人表示，对应付账款规模大、故意拉长账期或投诉较多的车企，将联合相关部门开展约谈并督促整改。
title_en: China Targets Automakers Delaying Supplier Payments Beyond 60-Day Limit
content_en:
China is stepping up oversight of automotive payment practices to protect suppliers. Commissioned by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers (CAAM) has launched an annual evaluation targeting 17 major automakers to enforce compliance with a 60-day payment deadline.

The assessment combines annual corporate reporting with random spot-checks of at least 15 suppliers per carmaker. Regulators will audit payment durations to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and verify payment methods, ensuring non-SME accounts meet standard terms with cash and bank acceptance drafts accounting for at least 80% of transactions.

Evaluation results will be submitted to MIIT and released publicly. Officials warned that automakers holding large accounts payable, intentionally delaying payments, or facing frequent supplier complaints will be summoned for formal regulatory talks and required to rectify their practices.

title_zh: 《文明》开发商 Firaxis 裁员约三分之一，工作室负责人将离职
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，《文明》和《XCOM》系列开发商 Firaxis 在 11 月 17 日裁减约 60 个岗位，约占员工总数的三分之一。母公司 Take-Two 旗下的 2K Games 还确认，工作室负责人 Heather Hazen 将离职。

Firaxis 在向 Ars Technica 提供的声明中表示，正重组并重新聚焦策略游戏这一核心优势，缩小团队规模，将重点放在设计、技术与玩家体验上。
title_en: Civilization Developer Firaxis Lays Off One-Third of Staff as Studio Head Steps Down
content_en:
Firaxis Games, the veteran developer behind the *Civilization* and *XCOM* franchises, cut approximately 60 jobs on November 17, reducing its workforce by nearly one-third. Publisher 2K Games, a subsidiary of Take-Two Interactive, also confirmed that studio head Heather Hazen is departing.

According to a company statement, the restructuring aims to refocus the studio on its core strength: strategy game development. Moving forward, a streamlined Firaxis team will concentrate its resources primarily on core game design, technical infrastructure, and player experience.

title_zh: 昆仑芯 M100 预计年底具备量产条件，百度 AI 云收入增长 94%
content_zh:
百度在第三季度业绩公告中披露，面向大规模 AI 推理优化的昆仑芯 M100，预计将于今年底前具备量产条件。这款芯片已于今年 7 月的世界人工智能大会首次公开亮相。

11 月 16 日公布的财报显示，百度第三季度营收约 308 亿元，同比下降 1%；按 GAAP 口径，归属百度的净利润约 14 亿元，非 GAAP 净利润约 24 亿元。

业务结构方面，智能云基础设施收入为 82 亿元，同比增长 94%，其中 GPU 云收入同比增长 191%；核心 AI 新业务收入为 132 亿元，占百度一般性业务收入的 53%。在线营销服务收入约 119 亿元，同比下降 22%。

百度第三季度经营现金流为正，达到约 28 亿元。公司还在财报中表示，千帆 MaaS 平台外部客户的 Token 使用收入同比增长 1159%。
title_en: Baidu AI Cloud Revenue Surges 94% as Kunlun M100 Chip Nears Mass Production
content_en:
Baidu announced in its Q3 earnings report that its mass-inference optimized Kunlun M100 AI chip is scheduled to achieve mass-production readiness by the end of this year. First unveiled at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in July, the chip highlights Baidu's continued push toward hardware autonomy.

For the third quarter, Baidu reported revenue of approximately 30.8 billion yuan ($4.2 billion), down 1% year-over-year, while non-GAAP net profit reached 2.4 billion yuan. Despite a 22% drop in online marketing revenue to 11.9 billion yuan, new core AI businesses expanded rapidly, accounting for 53% of the company's core operational revenue.

Growth was anchored by Baidu's Intelligent Cloud infrastructure, which surged 94% year-over-year to 8.2 billion yuan, boosted by a 191% jump in GPU cloud revenue. Additionally, external token usage revenue on the Qianfan Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) platform spiked 1,159% year-over-year, underscoring strong enterprise demand for enterprise AI tools.

title_zh: 联想 PC 及平板市场销售额份额超苹果，IDC 估算达 195 亿美元
content_zh:
联想提供的 IDC 2026 年第三季度全球个人计算设备跟踪报告显示，在包含台式机、笔记本电脑、工作站及平板电脑的市场中，联想销售额份额为 21.4%，出货量份额为 20.3%，两项均居第一。

按 IDC 估算的终端用户支出，联想该季度销售额为 195 亿美元，同比增长 7.4%；苹果为 190 亿美元，销售额份额为 20.9%，排名第二。联想的销售额份额较去年同期提高 1.3 个百分点。

出货量方面，联想为 1910 万台，苹果为 1720 万台。同期全球个人计算设备出货量约 9410 万台，同比下降 19.3%。
title_en: Lenovo Overtakes Apple in Global PC and Tablet Revenue Share, Reaching $19.5 Billion in Q3
content_en:
Lenovo secured the top global position in both revenue and shipment volume within the personal computing market during the third quarter, according to data from IDC’s Global Quarterly Personal Computing Device Tracker. The market encompasses desktops, laptops, workstations, and tablets.

Lenovo achieved a 21.4% revenue share and a 20.3% shipment share. Estimated end-user spending for Lenovo reached $19.5 billion, marking a 7.4% year-over-year increase. Apple followed in second place with $19.0 billion in revenue, capturing a 20.9% market share. Lenovo’s revenue share grew by 1.3 percentage points compared to the same period last year.

In terms of volume, Lenovo delivered 19.1 million units compared to Apple’s 17.2 million units. Overall global shipments for personal computing devices reached approximately 94.1 million units during the quarter, representing a 19.3% year-over-year decline.

title_zh: 何小鹏预计 11 月销量首超 6 万辆、人形机器人明年二季度面向商业客户发布
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，何小鹏在小鹏集团第三季度财报电话会上表示，预计 11 月销量将首次超过 6 万辆。公司给出的第四季度交付指引为 16.9 万至 17.4 万辆；第三季度实际交付 118390 辆，创单季新高。

海外业务方面，小鹏第三季度交付 27882 辆，10 月海外交付超过 1.3 万辆。公司第四季度国际业务销量目标超过 4 万辆，预计全年海外销量首次突破 10 万辆；按计划，2027 年将逐步向全球客户交付小鹏 NGP。

何小鹏还更新了人形机器人计划：首批量产机器人拟于明年第一季度进入部分小鹏门店试用，IRON 将于 2027 年第二季度面向外部商业客户正式发布。他表示，明年将把更多精力用于改善经营与增强汽车业务的自我造血能力，同时推进机器人的量产、交付。
title_en: XPeng Targets Record Monthly Deliveries and Outlines Humanoid Robot Commercialization Timeline
content_en:
XPeng Chairman and CEO He Xiaopeng announced during the company's Q3 earnings call that monthly deliveries are expected to top 60,000 units for the first time in November. For the fourth quarter, XPeng has set a delivery target of 169,000 to 174,000 vehicles, building on a record third quarter with 118,390 units delivered.

The Chinese EV maker is also expanding its international footprint. Overseas deliveries reached 27,882 units in Q3 and surpassed 13,000 units in October alone. XPeng aims to deliver over 40,000 vehicles internationally in Q4, putting annual overseas sales on track to cross 100,000 units for the first time. The company also plans to roll out its Navigation Guided Pilot (NGP) autonomous driving feature to global customers starting in 2027.

Alongside vehicle updates, He Xiaopeng detailed plans for XPeng's humanoid robot line. The first batch of mass-produced robots will undergo trial deployment in select XPeng showrooms in Q1 next year, while the commercial model, IRON, is scheduled for release to external enterprise clients in Q2 2027. Management intends to focus on improving operational efficiency and EV profitability while scaling robot production.

title_zh: 《NBA 2K27》将联动《GTA 6》，罪恶都市主题球场 11 月 27 日上线
content_zh:
2K 公布《NBA 2K27》第三赛季联动，将把《GTA 6》罪恶都市的场景风格带入篮球游戏。赛季名为「Vice City Takeover」，11 月 27 日上线，持续七周，至明年 1 月 15 日。

The City 将加入罪恶都市主题篮球公园，布置海滨球场、霓虹招牌、粉彩色酒店及鳄鱼吉祥物 Macca 雕像。玩家还可获得罪恶都市、洛圣都主题球衣，以及 Burger Shot、Cluckin」 Bell 等《GTA》虚构品牌服装。

MyTEAM 也将加入罪恶都市主题卡牌、限时挑战和赛季奖励。2K 同期推出数字版《NBA 2K27 罪恶都市版》，包含第三赛季 Pro Pass 与联动主题物品。

在 11 月 27 日至明年 1 月 15 日期间，PS5 和 Xbox Series X｜S 平台的 GTA＋会员可免费游玩《NBA 2K27》标准版；12 月 17 日起还可领取专属联动物品。
title_en: NBA 2K27 Partners with GTA 6 for 'Vice City Takeover' Crossover Event Starting Nov. 27
content_en:
2K has announced a crossover between *NBA 2K27* and *Grand Theft Auto VI*, bringing the iconic aesthetics of Vice City into the basketball simulation game. Titled "Vice City Takeover," Season 3 will launch on November 27 and run for seven weeks through January 15.

The update transforms "The City" with Vice City-themed outdoor courts, beachfront environments, neon signs, pastel-colored architecture, and a statue of Macca the alligator mascot. Players can unlock Vice City and Los Santos-themed apparel, including jerseys and clothing from fictional GTA brands like Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell. Additionally, the MyTEAM mode will feature themed player cards, limited-time challenges, and seasonal rewards, accompanied by a digital *NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition* bundle.

To celebrate the collaboration, GTA+ subscribers on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S will receive free access to the *NBA 2K27* Standard Edition throughout the event window. Subscribers will also be eligible to claim exclusive crossover cosmetics starting December 17.

title_zh: 王兴兴：机器人换场景就要重训，泛化能力是首要难题
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，王兴兴在 11 月 17 日 APEC 工商领导人峰会上表示，AI 和机器人公开展示的成果只是冰山一角，底层技术仍在快速迭代；不过，要让机器人适配不同家庭和工作环境，首先要解决模型泛化能力不足的问题。

他解释，大语言模型已在个人生活和办公中发挥越来越大的价值，提升了人们对技术应用的期待，大家因而希望机器人也能借助 AI 真正干活，解决工作中的实际问题。

他指出，现在机器人更换应用场景往往需要重新训练，难以做到一台设备在各类环境中立即干活。他判断，全球技术演进已经接近突破的临界点。

王兴兴同时提醒，即使机器人 AI 模型实现突破，制造能力、可靠性和售后服务仍需跟上：需求若从数万台上升到数百万乃至数千万台，产业链将承受很大压力。算力需求增长和使用安全也是规模化商用必须面对的问题。
title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing: Model Generalization Remains Top Hurdle for Robotics
content_en:
At the APEC CEO Summit on November 17, Wang Xingxing stated that current public achievements in AI and robotics represent just the tip of the iceberg, with underlying technologies continuing to evolve rapidly. However, enabling robots to adapt across different household and work environments requires first solving the lack of model generalization.

Wang explained that large language models have set higher expectations for AI applications, leading people to hope robots can leverage AI to perform real work and solve practical problems. Currently, changing a robot's deployment scenario typically requires retraining, making immediate operation across diverse settings difficult. Still, he believes global technology is nearing a critical breakthrough point.

He also cautioned that even if AI models break through, manufacturing capacity, reliability, and after-sales service must keep pace. Scaling demand from tens of thousands to millions or tens of millions of units will place immense pressure on the supply chain, alongside challenges in computing power and operational safety.

title_zh: 丘成桐：完全跟着 AI 的结论走，会失去独立提问的能力
content_zh:
丘成桐在《人民日报》11 月 17 日刊发的文章中谈到，AI 已从下棋、解奥数题发展到协助攻克长期悬置的数学难题，其影响将延伸到物理、化学、生物和工程等领域。他主张拥抱这一工具，同时守住独立提问和思考的能力。

他认为，当前 AI 还提供不了颠覆性的思想跃迁；若完全跟着 AI 给出的结论走，人们将失去独立提问、深度思考和创新突破的能力。重大科学突破往往始于前所未有的问题，以及对「什么值得追问」的判断，而这种判断与人的情感、直觉和好奇心紧密相连。

在人才培养上，他不主张死记硬背和反复刷题，介绍了用数学史课程帮助学生理解重要突破如何产生，以及让数学学生接触文学、历史和哲学的实践。他还建议为基础科学建立长周期评价体系，让年轻人能投入大问题，给予研究者静心做学问的环境。
title_en: Fields Medalist Shing-Tung Yau Warns Against Over-Reliance on AI in Research
content_en:
In an article published by *People's Daily* on November 17, mathematician Shing-Tung Yau discussed AI's evolution from playing chess to assisting with long-standing mathematical problems, noting its growing impact on physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering. He urged researchers to embrace AI while maintaining their capacity for independent questioning and deep thinking.

Yau argued that current AI cannot yet deliver disruptive conceptual leaps. Relying entirely on AI conclusions risks diminishing humanity's ability to ask novel questions and achieve creative breakthroughs, which often begin with intuition, curiosity, and human judgment about what is worth investigating.

To nurture talent, Yau cautioned against rote memorization and mechanical problem-solving. He highlighted educational practices such as using math history to demonstrate how breakthroughs occur, as well as exposing math students to literature, history, and philosophy. He also recommended establishing long-term evaluation systems for basic science to provide researchers with a stable environment to focus on fundamental challenges.

title_zh: 岚图取得道路机动车辆独立生产资质
content_zh:
岚图汽车 11 月 17 日晚在港交所公告，已正式取得道路机动车辆生产企业准入资格。

据界面新闻报道，工信部于 11 月 16 日发布 2026 年第 31 号公告，公布《道路机动车辆生产企业及产品》（第 412 批）目录，岚图被列入本批次道路机动车辆生产企业准入名单。
title_en: EV Maker Voyah Secures Independent Vehicle Manufacturing Approval
content_en:
Voyah Motors announced in a Hong Kong Stock Exchange filing on the evening of November 17 that it has officially obtained approval as an independent road motor vehicle manufacturing enterprise.

According to a Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) announcement released on November 16, Voyah was included in the 412th batch of the official catalog for road motor vehicle production enterprises and products, marking a key regulatory milestone for the electric vehicle brand.

title_zh: 工信部同意京沪等八省市开展 6G 创新试点
content_zh:
工信部 11 月 17 日公布复函，同意北京、河北、上海、江苏、浙江、安徽、湖北、广东八个省市开展 6G 创新发展部省协同试点。

复函要求，各地结合 6G 国际标准和产业研发实际，发挥地方产业优势，重点在培育 6G 应用产业、夯实基础产业、探索新型产品路线等方面加强攻关。工信部将定期组织试点评价，并在技术试验、频率保障、项目布局和成果应用等方面提供支持。

试点项目如涉及商业应用，企业须依规取得相关电信业务经营许可；涉及无线电频率、台站及发射设备时，也须依法取得相应许可、执照和型号核准。
title_en: China Approves 6G Innovation Pilot Projects Across Eight Key Regions
content_en:
China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has officially approved eight provinces and municipalities—including Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangdong—to launch collaborative pilot programs for 6G innovation and development.

The initiative aims to leverage local industrial strengths alongside international 6G standards. Participating regions will focus on nurturing 6G applications, strengthening foundational industries, and developing next-generation product architectures. To support these efforts, MIIT will provide assistance in technical testing, radio frequency allocation, project deployment, and practical implementation, alongside conducting regular evaluation assessments.

The regulatory framework requires participating enterprises to secure appropriate telecommunications operating permits for commercial applications, as well as necessary licenses and approvals for radio spectrum, station deployment, and transmission equipment.

title_zh: AMD 芯片进入 202 台 TOP500 超算，Lux 首次入榜排第 14
content_zh:
AMD 在 SC26 期间公布，最新一期 TOP500 全球超算榜单中，采用 AMD 技术的系统达到 202 台，占总数超过 40%，系统数量同比增加约 14%；本期新入榜系统中，约一半采用 AMD 技术。

榜单前十中，El Capitan、Frontier、HPC7、HPC6 四套系统使用 AMD 芯片，分别排名第二、第三、第六和第八。AMD 还表示，Green500 能效榜前十中有四套系统、前五十中超过半数采用其技术。

首次入榜的 Lux 位列第 14，HPL 实测性能为 220.79 PFLOPS。该系统由 HPE 建造，部署于美国橡树岭国家实验室，结合 AMD EPYC 处理器、Instinct MI355X GPU、Pensando 网络与 ROCm 软件，面向 AI 驱动的科研及高性能模拟，现已向科研用户开放。
title_en: AMD Powers Over 40% of World’s Top 500 Supercomputers as New "Lux" System Debuts at No. 14
content_en:
AMD has strengthened its position in high-performance computing, powering 202 systems in the latest TOP500 supercomputer list—accounting for over 40% of total entries and marking a 14% year-over-year increase. Notably, approximately half of all new systems joining the list are built on AMD technology.

AMD chips power four of the world's top ten supercomputers, including El Capitan (#2), Frontier (#3), HPC7 (#6), and HPC6 (#8). The chipmaker also demonstrated strong energy efficiency, with its hardware powering four of the top ten systems and over half of the top 50 in the Green500 rankings.

Among the newest additions is "Lux," which debuted at No. 14 with a benchmark performance of 220.79 PFLOPS. Built by HPE for the Oak Ridge National Laboratory, Lux integrates AMD EPYC processors, Instinct MI355X GPUs, Pensando networking, and ROCm software to drive AI-accelerated scientific research and high-performance simulations.

title_zh: 英伟达设董事会专门委员会，监督国家安全与芯片出口合规
content_zh:
英伟达 11 月 17 日宣布，董事会设立常设的「国家安全与出口管制监督委员会」，监督公司的国家安全政策、出口管制合规及全球贸易风险管理。

委员会由独立董事苏珊娜·诺拉·约翰逊担任主席，斯蒂芬·尼尔与约翰·达比里担任委员。英伟达现有的国家安全团队和全球贸易合规团队，将向该委员会及临时 CEO 科莱特·克雷斯汇报日常运营情况。

新委员会至少每季度开会一次，包括与管理层举行会议及独立董事闭门会议，并将聘请法律、国家安全和全球贸易合规领域的独立专家。董事会主席哈维·琼斯表示，先进芯片及人工智能的发展带来新的国家安全挑战，公司希望加强与政府及行业伙伴的合作。
title_en: Nvidia Forms Board Committee to Oversee National Security and Export Controls
content_en:
Nvidia has established a standing "National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee" under its Board of Directors to enhance oversight of national security policies, export compliance, and global trade risk management.

Chaired by independent director Susanne Nora Johnson alongside members Stephen Neal and John Dabiri, the committee will oversee the operations of Nvidia’s national security and global trade compliance teams. The operational teams will report directly to the committee and Interim CEO Colette Kress.

The committee will meet at least quarterly for joint sessions with executive management and executive sessions with independent directors, while engaging external experts in law, national security, and trade compliance. Board Chair Harvey Jones emphasized that the rapid evolution of advanced semiconductor technology and AI introduces novel security challenges, requiring closer alignment with government and industry partners.

title_zh: 红果短剧招聘电视端产品经理，拟从零搭建大屏产品
content_zh:
字节跳动正在招聘红果短剧 OTT 端产品经理，岗位职责包括从零搭建大屏、电视端产品，并推动红果主端与 OTT 端协同。

招聘信息列出了首页推荐、分类导航、搜索、追剧等内容分发功能，要求参与 OTT 牌照申请，搭建内容送审与审核回传链路，并对接牌照方、硬件厂商等外部合作方。

商业化方面，该岗位将设计电视端变现路径，探索投屏会员、会员订阅和衍生权益等模式。任职要求包括三年以上产品经理经验，具有 OTT、IPTV、智能电视或大屏视频完整项目经验者优先。
title_en: ByteDance’s Hongguo Short Drama Expands to Big Screens with New TV Product Manager Role
content_en:
ByteDance is preparing to bring its popular short drama app, Hongguo, to television screens. The company is recruiting an OTT (Over-the-Top) Product Manager to build a dedicated big-screen experience from scratch and drive synergy between its mobile and TV platforms.

According to the job posting, the role involves designing core content distribution features, including homepage recommendations, category navigation, search, and watchlists. The product manager will also oversee OTT licensing compliance, establish content review workflows, and manage partnerships with hardware manufacturers and licensing authorities.

To monetize the platform, the role will focus on developing TV-specific revenue models, exploring avenues such as screen-casting memberships, standard subscriptions, and exclusive perks. Candidates are required to have at least three years of product management experience, preferably in OTT, IPTV, or smart TV video services.

title_zh: 哈萨比斯旗下 Isomorphic Labs 融资 50 亿美元，推进 AI 药物研发
content_zh:
由 Demis Hassabis（德米斯·哈萨比斯）创办的 AI 药物研发公司 Isomorphic Labs，11 月 17 日宣布完成 50 亿美元 C 轮融资。Greenoaks 与红杉资本共同领投，a16z 等新投资者参与，Alphabet 及原有投资者继续出资。

公司计划把资金用于扩展自有药物设计引擎 IsoDDE、推进内部及合作方的候选药物管线，并建设面向 AI 生物工程的全球基础设施。IsoDDE 将多种基础模拟模型整合在一起，用于探索化学空间、设计和优化分子。

Isomorphic Labs 称，内部肿瘤学、免疫学项目及合作项目已取得积极的临床前结果。新资金还将支持转化研究和临床开发设施建设，推动首批治疗项目进入临床试验。
title_en: Demis Hassabis’s Isomorphic Labs Secures $5 Billion to Advance AI Drug Discovery
content_en:
Isomorphic Labs, the AI-driven drug discovery company founded by Demis Hassabis, announced on November 17 that it raised $5 billion in Series C funding. The round was co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, with participation from new investor Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), alongside ongoing support from Alphabet and existing investors.

The fresh capital will be used to scale IsoDDE, the company's proprietary drug design engine, advance both internal and partner drug pipelines, and construct global infrastructure tailored for AI bioengineering. IsoDDE integrates multiple foundational simulation models to explore chemical spaces and optimize molecular designs.

Isomorphic Labs highlighted positive preclinical results in its internal oncology and immunology projects as well as collaborative efforts. The funding will also support translational research and clinical infrastructure to help transition its initial therapeutic programs into human clinical trials.

title_zh: 京东三季度收入增长 3.5%，新业务经营亏损收窄
content_zh:
京东 11 月 17 日发布第三季度财报，期内收入为 3095.93 亿元，同比增长 3.5%；归属于普通股股东的净利润约 65 亿元，非美国通用会计准则下的归母净利润约 83 亿元，同比增长 44%。

零售业务收入同比增长 2.9%，经营利润约 151 亿元，经营利润率为 5.8%。京东物流收入同比增长 16.1%。包含京东外卖、京喜、京东产发及海外业务的新业务板块，经营亏损由上年同期的 157.36 亿元收窄至 96.42 亿元。

公司表示，外卖与京喜推动新业务减亏。第三季度营销费用同比下降 26.2%，研发费用则同比增长 36.9%。季度自由现金流为净流出 238.61 亿元；截至 9 月底的过去十二个月，自由现金流为净流入 188.03 亿元。
title_en: JD.com Reports 3.5% Revenue Growth in Q3 as New Business Losses Narrow
content_en:
JD.com released its third-quarter earnings report on November 17, posting revenue of 309.59 billion yuan, a 3.5% year-over-year increase. Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders stood at 6.5 billion yuan, while non-GAAP net income surged 44% year-over-year to 8.3 billion yuan.

Performance across key segments remained solid. JD Retail recorded a 2.9% year-over-year revenue increase with an operating profit of 15.1 billion yuan (an operating margin of 5.8%), while JD Logistics posted a 16.1% revenue growth.

Operating losses for the New Businesses segment—encompassing food delivery, Jingxi, JD Property, and overseas operations—narrowed significantly from 15.74 billion yuan a year earlier to 9.64 billion yuan, largely aided by efficiency gains in food delivery and Jingxi.

During the quarter, marketing expenses fell 26.2% year-over-year, whereas R&D spending rose 36.9%. While Q3 free cash flow posted a net outflow of 23.86 billion yuan, trailing 12-month free cash flow through September recorded a net inflow of 18.80 billion yuan.

title_zh: 雷军：AI 落地场景仍有限，真正挣钱的公司较少
content_zh:
据《科创板日报》报道，雷军在 11 月 17 日的 APEC 工商领导人峰会上表示，过去四年 AI 大模型技术发展迅速，但投入很大、可落地场景有限，真正实现商业闭环并挣钱的公司仍然较少。

他认为，AI 与手机、汽车等终端和具体场景结合，将带来新的商业机会；过去四年，AI 手机和 AI 汽车还没有出现革命性的标杆产品，他相信未来几年这些领域会诞生重要产品。雷军提出，AI 可能值得被用来重塑每一个产业，企业可以从 AI 的模式、思维与技术三个方面重新考虑原有业务。

雷军以制造业为例称，小米已用 AI 优化工厂生产环节，并在探索把工厂发展为能够自主生产、发现问题与迭代的工业智能体。他还表示，小米研发机器人已有六年，近期进入工厂「实习」的机器人可完整工作八小时，其间自主充电两次。

谈及长期前景，雷军表示，具身智能机器人未来会成为巨大的产业机会，「它的想象力应该会超过汽车产业」。
title_en: Lei Jun Warns of Limited AI Use Cases and Low Industry Profitability
content_en:
Speaking at the APEC CEO Summit on November 17, Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun noted that despite four years of rapid large language model (LLM) development and massive capital investment, practical AI deployment scenarios remain limited, with very few companies achieving profitable business models.

Lei highlighted that integrating AI with hardware like smartphones and smart vehicles will unlock significant new opportunities. While revolutionary benchmark products have yet to emerge in the AI phone and auto sectors, he expects breakthrough devices in the coming years, urging businesses to leverage AI to reshape their operations.

Demonstrating Xiaomi's own progress, Lei shared that the company already uses AI to optimize factory operations and is building autonomous "industrial AI agents." Additionally, Xiaomi's robotics team—in development for six years—recently deployed humanoid robots for factory test runs, where they operated autonomously for eight-hour shifts including self-charging. Lei expressed confidence that embodied AI robotics will eventually evolve into a massive industry larger than the automotive sector.

title_zh: 💡 李彦宏：AI 应用若不能提升营收与利润，泡沫风险将加剧
content_zh:
李彦宏在 11 月 17 日 APEC 工商领导人峰会的对话中表示，过去三年多 AI 技术快速迭代，各方面投入成倍增长，但应用层渗透低于预期，许多企业使用 AI 后，营收和利润并没有明显提升。他认为，如果不解决这个问题，AI 可能变成泡沫，今年最紧迫的任务是找到真正适合 AI 的应用场景。

在他看来，AI 的价值最终来自应用层：芯片、云基础设施和模型的进步，只有进入企业与组织的实际工作，才能转化为经济价值。应用之上，还需要与之匹配的组织能力。

他以电力革命作类比：电机装进工厂后，如果没有流水线和组织方式的变化，对经济的推动仍很有限。结合百度的实践，他提出智能组织的三个原则：打破岗位边界、沉淀隐性知识，以及形成工作流闭环。

无人驾驶是他给出的应用样本。李彦宏称，无人驾驶出租车投入运营后的安全记录约为人类司机的 10 倍，并希望更多国家和经济体开放道路。他还介绍了百度在迪拜扩大运营范围、与 Uber 和 Lyft 在伦敦开展测试的进展。

谈到算力短缺，他提出通过「Token 交易所」匹配供给方和有推理需求的客户，把资源聚合起来。对于产业合作，他强调企业应各自发挥优势，集中精力共同把具体应用做成。
title_en: Baidu CEO Robin Li Warns of AI Bubble Risk Without Clear Revenue Impact
content_en:
At the APEC CEO Summit on November 17, Baidu CEO Robin Li warned that AI risks becoming a bubble if enterprise adoption fails to deliver tangible revenue and profit growth. Despite exponential increases in AI investments over the past three years, application penetration remains lower than expected, making the search for practical, value-generating use cases the industry's most urgent task.

Li emphasized that the value of chips, cloud infrastructure, and AI models can only be realized when integrated into actual organizational workflows. Drawing a parallel to the industrial electricity revolution, he noted that technology alone yields limited economic impact without structural changes. To adapt, he proposed three organizational principles: breaking job boundaries, institutionalizing implicit knowledge, and creating closed-loop workflows.

As a prime example of practical application, Li pointed to autonomous driving, stating that Baidu's robotaxis are roughly ten times safer than human drivers. He detailed international expansion efforts, including broader operations in Dubai and testing partnerships with Uber and Lyft in London. To address compute shortages, Li proposed a "Token Exchange" model to aggregate idle resources and efficiently match supply with inference demand.

title_zh: 359 元，索尼 MDR-3R 国行发布，复刻初代 Walkman 耳机
content_zh:
索尼中国 11 月 17 日发布 MDR-3R 复古有线小头戴耳机。新品以 1979 年随初代 Walkman 推出的 MDR-3 系列耳机为设计原型，保留金属头梁、原版标识和开放式贴耳结构，整机约重 38 克。

耳机采用 23mm 驱动单元，连接方式改为 USB-C，无需蓝牙配对或单独充电。线控可调节音量、播放暂停和切歌，内置麦克风支持免提通话，长按可唤醒语音助手。

标准版附带蓝色与橙色两套可更换耳垫。索尼注明，耳机兼容 USB Audio Class 1.0 设备，具体操作取决于连接设备、系统和应用；这款产品的 USB-C 连接并非为 Walkman 设备设计，官方也不建议搭配 Walkman 使用。

🔗 相关阅读：300 块的索尼复古耳机，没降噪不隔音，为什么还是卖爆了？
title_en: Sony Launches Retro MDR-3R Wired Headphones in China for ¥359
content_en:
Sony China has released the MDR-3R retro wired lightweight headphones, priced at 359 RMB. Modeled after the iconic 1979 MDR-3 headphones bundled with the original Walkman, the 38-gram headset features a classic metal headband, original branding, open-back on-ear architecture, and replaceable blue and orange ear pads.

Updated for modern devices, the MDR-3R features a USB-C connection instead of a traditional audio jack, eliminating the need for Bluetooth pairing or battery charging. Powered by 23mm driver units, it includes inline controls for media playback, volume adjustment, hands-free calls, and voice assistant activation.

Notably, Sony clarified that the USB-C setup is compliant with USB Audio Class 1.0 devices but is not designed for traditional or digital Walkman players, officially advising against using the headphones with Walkman devices.

title_zh: 任天堂 eShop 加入家庭组赠礼，可赠游戏、DLC 和升级包
content_zh:
任天堂宣布，Switch 与 Switch 2 的 eShop 从 11 月 17 日起加入数字赠礼功能，用户可向家庭组中的其他成员购买并赠送符合条件的游戏、DLC 和升级包。主机需运行 23.5.0 或更新系统，家庭组最多可容纳 8 个账号。

购买时，用户在商品页勾选「Give as a Gift」，选择家庭组成员及其关联主机，再设置包装颜色并付款。礼物会立即发送，接收方可在主机 HOME 菜单中接受并游玩。

部分商品不支持赠礼，受监督账号不能发送礼物，任天堂也限制一定时间内可购买的赠礼数量。
title_en: Nintendo eShop Introduces Digital Gifting for Family Groups
content_en:
Nintendo has introduced a digital gifting feature for the eShop on Switch and Switch 2 consoles. Effective November 17, users can purchase and send eligible games, downloadable content (DLC), and upgrade packs to other members within their Family Group.

To use the feature, consoles must run system version 23.5.0 or later, with Family Groups supporting up to eight accounts. Buyers simply select the "Give as a Gift" option on eligible product pages, choose a recipient and their linked console, select a wrapping color, and complete the payment. Gifts are delivered immediately and can be accepted directly from the recipient's HOME menu.

Certain items are excluded from gifting, supervised accounts are restricted from sending gifts, and Nintendo has implemented limits on the number of gifts that can be purchased within a given timeframe.

title_zh: 51.99 万元，东风猛士 M817 Ultimate 上市
content_zh:
东风猛士 M817 Ultimate 智能越野大师于 11 月 17 日上市，指导价为 51.99 万元。新车采用 2.0T 插混动力系统，综合功率超过 1000 马力。

车辆采用 800V 高压架构与 6C 超充，配备自适应阻尼氮气减振、差速锁与智能 E 锁，支持后轮转向、坦克转弯和蠕行模式，标称涉水深度为 900mm。

座舱采用 HarmonySpace 6，驾驶辅助部分搭载华为乾崑 ADS 5 与 896 线激光雷达，支持面向非铺装路面的 NCA 越野辅助功能。
title_en: Dongfeng Mengshi Launches M817 Ultimate Off-Roader at 519,900 Yuan
content_en:
Dongfeng Mengshi officially launched the M817 Ultimate intelligent off-road SUV, priced at 519,900 yuan. Powered by a 2.0T plug-in hybrid system, the vehicle delivers a combined output exceeding 1,000 horsepower.

Built on an 800V high-voltage architecture with 6C ultra-fast charging capability, the M817 Ultimate comes equipped with adaptive nitrogen dampers, differential locks, and smart E-locks. It supports advanced off-road capabilities including rear-wheel steering, tank turns, crawl mode, and a rated wading depth of 900mm.

Inside, the SUV features the HarmonySpace 6 cockpit. Its driver-assistance system is powered by Huawei Qiankun ADS 5, utilizing an 896-line LiDAR to support Navigation Cruise Assist (NCA) tailored specifically for unpaved terrain.

title_zh: 华为星芒 OSTA O1 Pro 开启预约，11 月 20 日晚首销
content_zh:
星芒首款手机 OSTA O1 Pro 已在华为商城开启预约。官方商品页显示，预约从 11 月 17 日 10:08 持续至 11 月 20 日 14:30，新品首销安排在 11 月 20 日 18:08。

手机提供星空黑、星云白和星芒紫三款配色。当前星芒紫商品页列出的版本为 16GB + 512GB 和 16GB + 1TB，商品名称标注双卡全网通。

外观采用阔直板形态，后置双摄横向置于圆角矩形模组。星芒紫的机身呈渐变色，侧边电源键也采用紫色。
title_en: Pre-Orders Open for Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro Ahead of November 20 Launch
content_en:
Pre-orders for the Xingmang OSTA O1 Pro smartphone have officially opened on the Huawei VMall. According to the product listing, the pre-order window runs until November 20 at 14:30, with official sales commencing later that evening at 18:08.

The handset is available in three colorways: Starry Black, Nebula White, and Xingmang Purple. Listed configurations for the purple variant include 16GB+512GB and 16GB+1TB options, both supporting dual-SIM functionality.

Featuring a sleek flat-frame design, the device sports a horizontal dual-camera setup housed within a rounded rectangular module. The Xingmang Purple edition features a gradient back finish along with a matching purple power button.

title_zh: 商汤开源 Loop-9B 正式版，复用模型层扩展推理深度
content_zh:
商汤 11 月 17 日开放 SenseNova-Loop-9B 正式版的模型权重与代码，并同步提供官方 AWQ 4bit 量化版。模型约有 90 亿参数，可接收文本和图像、输出文本，最长支持 512K Token 上下文。

它通过重复执行中间的共享层，在保存 32 组解码层权重的情况下，完成 56 次层计算。相比直接增加参数，这种循环结构尝试用更多计算深度提升推理、代码和工具调用能力。

官方估算，4bit 模型权重约占 4.9GB；在 64K 上下文、4bit KV 缓存配置下，最低显存需求约为 9GiB；若使用 256K 上下文与 8bit KV 缓存，则约需 15GiB。

在商汤公布的评测中，正式版在七项测试上均高于 Preview 版；NL2Repo 得分为 41.36，Qwen3.8-27B 为 44.60，AIDABench 两者分别为 65.31 和 65.01。
title_en: SenseTime Open-Sources SenseNova-Loop-9B: Deepening Inference Through Layer Reuse
content_en:
SenseTime has officially open-sourced the model weights and code for its multimodal model, SenseNova-Loop-9B, alongside an official AWQ 4-bit quantized edition. Featuring approximately 9 billion parameters, the model accepts text and image inputs, outputs text, and supports an extended context window of up to 512K tokens.

Setting itself apart from traditional scaling, the model utilizes a recurrent architecture that performs 56 layer computations while storing only 32 sets of decoder layer weights. By repeatedly executing shared intermediate layers, SenseNova-Loop-9B increases compute depth to boost reasoning, coding, and tool-calling performance without unnecessarily inflating parameter count.

Hardware requirements remain manageable: the 4-bit quantized weights occupy roughly 4.9GB of storage. A 64K context window paired with a 4-bit KV cache requires a minimum of 9GiB VRAM, while a 256K context with an 8-bit KV cache demands about 15GiB. Official benchmarks show that this full release outperforms its preview version across all seven evaluation suites.

title_zh: 微软 MAI Code 2 上线 Copilot，同步扩展图像、语音与安全模型
content_zh:
微软在 Ignite 2026 公布 MAI 模型家族更新，覆盖企业编程、网络安全、图像和语音，并推出可由企业定制、部署在自身 Azure 环境中的 MAI Licensed Weights。

微软还宣布 Decision 1.1 正式可用，供企业将任务路由到合适的模型。Licensed Weights 允许客户用自己的数据定制模型，再在自身 Azure 环境中控制访问，数据与定制成果归客户所有。
title_en: Microsoft Expands MAI Model Family and Introduces Custom Enterprise Licensing
content_en:
At Ignite 2026, Microsoft announced major updates to its MAI model family, broadening capabilities across enterprise coding, cybersecurity, image, and voice processing. 

To give organizations greater control, Microsoft launched MAI Licensed Weights, allowing enterprise clients to fine-tune models using their proprietary data. These customized models can be deployed securely within the customer's own Azure environment, ensuring complete data ownership and governance.

Additionally, Microsoft officially released Decision 1.1, a routing tool designed to help enterprises dynamically direct tasks to the most suitable AI models for improved efficiency.

title_zh: VSCO 首款原生 Mac 修图应用上线，可批量编辑 500 张照片
content_zh:
据 9to5Mac 报道，VSCO 发布首款原生 Mac 照片编辑应用 Studio Pro Desktop，支持 RAW 处理、批量编辑和直接向客户交付成片。应用可从 Apple 照片、文件夹、SD 卡与外置硬盘导入照片，兼容 20 个品牌的逾 800 款相机。

Studio Pro Desktop 将苹果 Core Image RAW 处理与 VSCO 的 Reflex 图像引擎结合，提供超过 200 种预设，可同时对 2 至 500 张照片应用预设和调整，并实时预览。完成后可导出到本地，也能直接发布至 VSCO Galleries 分享全分辨率照片。

Wired 的实际试用指出，应用处理 RAW 和预览速度较快，但蒙版、曲线和擦除工具仍待后续加入。Studio Pro Desktop 面向 Apple 芯片 Mac 免费提供下载，完整功能需 VSCO Pro 或 VSCO One 会员。
title_en: VSCO Launches Studio Pro Desktop for Mac Featuring 500-Photo Batch Editing
content_en:
VSCO has released Studio Pro Desktop, its first native Mac photo-editing application. Designed for professional creators, the app supports RAW processing, batch editing for 2 to 500 photos simultaneously with real-time previews, and direct client delivery options. It connects smoothly with Apple Photos, local folders, SD cards, and external hard drives, supporting over 800 camera models across 20 brands.

The application combines Apple's Core Image RAW processing with VSCO's Reflex rendering engine, delivering more than 200 presets. Edited photos can be exported locally or published directly to VSCO Galleries in full resolution.

According to a hands-on review by *Wired*, the software excels in RAW processing speed and preview performance, though tools like masking, curves, and object removal are planned for future updates. Studio Pro Desktop is free to download for Apple Silicon Macs, with full feature availability reserved for VSCO Pro or VSCO One subscribers.

title_zh: 小红书内测「搭搭」App，用户可创建 AI 搭子并拉入群聊
content_zh:
据《读佳》报道，小红书正在内测一款独立 App「搭搭」。它以领域 Agent 社区为定位，让用户把设计、求职、学习等方面的经验做成 AI 智能体，再分享给其他人使用；这些智能体在产品内被称为「搭子」。

内测版已提供设计美学等数十个搭子，支持图文对话。用户也可新建群组，把真人好友和搭子加入同一个会话，并通过邀请链接让更多人参与。

《读佳》的产品体验显示，设计美学搭子在接到装修需求后，会先询问居住人口、预算、户型及采光等条件，再继续讨论方案。用户可通过创造者平台搭建自己的搭子，把个人经验和咨询流程设置为对话框架。

产品个人中心还提供绑定小红书账号的入口。用户授权后，搭子可读取小红书公开主页信息，用于了解偏好、调整回答。
title_en: Xiaohongshu Tests 'Dada': A New AI Companion App for Group Chats and Expertise Sharing
content_en:
Chinese social platform Xiaohongshu is currently beta-testing a standalone app named "Dada," designed as a specialized AI agent community. The platform allows users to convert their personal expertise—in fields such as interior design, career counseling, and academic studying—into custom AI companions called "Dazi" to share with others.

The app supports group chats, enabling users to bring both real-life friends and AI agents into the same conversation. Through a dedicated creator platform, users can structure their consulting workflows into interactive conversational templates.

Additionally, Dada allows users to bind their Xiaohongshu accounts. With user consent, AI companions can read public profile information to better understand personal preferences and tailor their responses accordingly.

title_zh: 影目 INMO Future 开启预约，采用双目全彩显示与空间交互
content_zh:
影目 INMO Future 空间智能眼镜已在京东自营页面提供 1 元预订入口。该产品此前于 11 月 4 日发布，发布价为 5999 元，是影目的第四代一体式 AI＋AR 眼镜，无需外接主机。

据北京商报现场报道，INMO Future 搭载高通骁龙空间处理芯片，采用双目 1080P 全彩阵列光波导显示，视场角为 36 度，入眼亮度最高 800 尼特，支持双目异显。

空间交互方面，眼镜通过 SLAM、六自由度追踪等实现空间定位和锚定，让数字内容留在对应的现实位置。系统为基于 Android 14 定制的空间 AIOS，可安装兼容的安卓应用，覆盖观影、多窗口办公、游戏以及 PC、主机画面串流等场景。
title_en: INMO Opens Pre-Orders for 'INMO Future' Binocular Full-Color AR Glasses
content_en:
INMO has officially opened pre-orders for its latest all-in-one spatial smart glasses, the INMO Future, on JD.com. Priced at 5,999 yuan, this fourth-generation AI+AR device functions entirely untethered without requiring an external compute unit.

Powered by a Qualcomm Snapdragon spatial processing platform, the glasses feature binocular 1080P full-color optical waveguide displays, offering a 36-degree field of view and up to 800 nits of peak brightness. Spatial positioning is driven by SLAM and 6DoF tracking, anchoring digital contents precisely within physical environments.

The headset operates on a custom Android 14-based spatial AIOS. It supports compatible Android applications across various use cases, including multi-window productivity, video streaming, gaming, and display mirroring from PCs and consoles.

title_zh: 大疆调价今起生效，Osmo Pocket 4P 标准套装现售 4099 元
content_zh:
大疆部分产品建议零售价调整于 11 月 18 日零时生效。大疆此前在官方商城说明，调价原因是全球半导体、存储等关键零部件成本持续大幅上涨。

截至今晨，官方商城显示 Osmo Pocket 4P 标准套装为 4099 元，Vlog 套装为 4859 元。标准套装包含主相机、补光灯、螺纹手柄、便携收纳袋和 USB 快充线等配件。

Pocket 4P 采用广角与中焦双摄，其中中焦镜头为等效 60mm，支持 3 倍光学变焦。
title_en: DJI Implements Price Hikes Due to Component Costs; Osmo Pocket 4P Starts at 4,099 Yuan
content_en:
DJI's price adjustments across select product lines officially went into effect today. According to the company, the price increases were driven by significant and continuous cost surges for global semiconductor and memory components.

Following the update, the Osmo Pocket 4P standard bundle is now priced at 4,099 yuan on DJI's official online store, while the Vlog combo sells for 4,859 yuan. The standard package includes the main camera unit, a fill light, a threaded handle, a carrying pouch, and a fast-charging USB cable.

The Pocket 4P features a dual-camera setup, incorporating a wide-angle lens alongside an equivalent 60mm mid-telephoto lens capable of 3x optical zoom.

title_zh: WorkBuddy 支持跨设备迁移，可导入对话、产物与定时任务
content_zh:
腾讯 WorkBuddy 11 月 17 日宣布支持跨设备导入数据，同一账号下的新电脑可接续原电脑的任务、对话记录、产物及定时任务。迁移范围还包括任务分组、关联文件夹的主次关系、分组记忆和任务本地 Skill。

两台电脑均需更新至最新版本、登录同一账号，并在迁移时保持在线、打开 WorkBuddy 及「允许移动设备远程连接」开关。用户可在设置的「数据导入」中选择另一台电脑，完成后查看导入历史。

导入的定时任务默认关闭，避免两台电脑重复执行；再次导入同一任务会自动跳过已有记录。产物按原设备名称分别存放，单个产物不得超过 100MB。MCP 配置、日志，以及全局下发的 Skill、专家和记忆不在迁移范围内。
title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy Launches Cross-Device Migration for Seamless Data Transfer
content_en:
Tencent's WorkBuddy has introduced support for cross-device data migration, enabling users to seamlessly transfer conversations, task histories, artifacts, and scheduled tasks to a new computer logged into the same account. The migration process also covers task groupings, linked folder hierarchies, group memories, and local Skills.

To perform a transfer, both computers must run the latest version of WorkBuddy, log into the same account, remain online, and enable the "Allow Remote Device Connection" setting. Users can initiate the migration by selecting their source device under Settings > Data Import.

To prevent duplicate execution, imported scheduled tasks are disabled by default, and re-importing identical tasks automatically skips existing records. Individual artifact sizes are capped at 100MB. Note that MCP configurations, logs, and globally deployed Skills, experts, and memories are excluded from the migration.

title_zh: TGA 2026 公布提名，《GTA 6》领跑、《影之刃零》角逐年度游戏
content_zh:
The Game Awards 公布 2026 年提名，《GTA 6》以 8 项提名领跑。在年度游戏奖项中，它将与《007 初露锋芒》《控制：共振》《影之刃零》《生化危机：安魂曲》和《塞尔达传说 时之笛》竞争。

据 Eurogamer 报道，《GTA 6》的提名还涵盖最佳游戏指导、叙事、美术、配乐、音效设计、动作冒险游戏，以及饰演露西亚的 Manni L. Perez 获得的最佳表演。任天堂以 12 项成为提名最多的发行商，卡普空为 11 项。

虽然《GTA 6》要到 11 月 19 日才发售，但负责提名的逾 160 家媒体和创作者机构可提前接触游戏，因此作品得以在上市前入围。

颁奖礼将于当地时间 12 月 10 日在洛杉矶孔雀剧院举行，观众可在美西时间 12 月 9 日 18 时前通过 TGA 官网投票；典礼将通过 YouTube、Twitch、Steam 等平台免费播放。
title_en: TGA 2026 Nominations Revealed: 'GTA VI' Leads with 8 Nods
content_en:
The Game Awards (TGA) 2026 has officially announced its nominees, with *Grand Theft Auto VI* leading the lineup with eight nominations. It will compete for Game of the Year alongside *007: First Light*, *Control: Resonance*, *Phantom Blade Zero*, *Resident Evil: Requiem*, and *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time*.

In addition to GOTY, *GTA VI* earned nods for Best Game Direction, Narrative, Art Direction, Score, Audio Design, Action/Adventure, and Best Performance for Manni L. Perez as Lucia. Among publishers, Nintendo led overall with 12 nominations, followed by Capcom with 11. Although *GTA VI* releases on November 19, over 160 voting media outlets and creators received early access to evaluate the title for eligibility.

The ceremony will take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 10, streamed live globally on platforms including YouTube, Twitch, and Steam. Fan voting remains open on the official TGA website until 6:00 PM PT on December 9.

title_zh: 康师傅用豆包工作搭平台，追查 77 条产线的面饼损耗
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，康师傅团队在豆包工作的帮助下，用妙搭搭建面饼重量管理平台，目前已覆盖 14 家工厂、77 条产线。平台把原本需要人工下载、导入的产线数据改为每日自动汇集，连接两端的传输代码由豆包工作协助编写，再由团队调试。

负责制面规划的杨伟是食品专业背景，没有 IT 经验，但熟悉业务指标。团队把计算方式和异常条件交给 AI，平台据此生成分析、提醒，并按重量规格比较不同产线的波动、损耗和直通率，为每条产线提供「体检单」，把有效做法汇入知识库。

一次排查发现，工人开盖查看面团的动作会打断和面，使面饼重量波动持续三至五分钟。团队对照曲线重做实验后，调整了开盖时机和方式。据项目团队统计，截至 2026 年 8 月，整套重量管理项目累计创效 1900 万元，来自称重设备、数据分析和现场改善的共同作用。
title_en: Master Kong Leverages ByteDance's Doubao AI to Cut Noodle Waste Across 77 Lines
content_en:
Instant noodle giant Master Kong (Kangshifu) has leveraged ByteDance's Doubao Work platform to build an automated weight management system across 14 factories and 77 production lines. The platform automates daily production data collection, replacing manual workflows using data transmission code co-written with AI.

Led by Yang Wei, a food science specialist with no IT background, the project team supplied business metrics and calculation rules to the AI. The system now automatically generates analytical reports and alerts, tracks weight fluctuations and first-pass yield, and issues "health check" reports for each production line to build an enterprise knowledge base.

In one instance, data analysis revealed that workers opening lids to inspect dough disrupted the mixing process, triggering weight fluctuations lasting several minutes. By adjusting operational timing and on-site practices, the combined weight management initiative generated 19 million RMB in cumulative savings by August 2026.

title_zh: 两部门要求普及「一键看电视」，整治面向老年人的违规医药广告
content_zh:
国家广播电视总局、民政部 11 月 17 日公布通知，要求进一步解决老年观众「看电视难、看电视烦」的问题，加快普及一个遥控器「一键看电视」，推广一体化电视、插入式微型机顶盒等便捷终端。

通知要求发布图文版电视收看「明白卡」，优化功能和界面、频道序号设置，完善大屏点播、回看、断点续看和倍速播放。各地还应摸清老年人有线电视优惠政策落实情况，支持有条件地区通过政府购买服务等方式，为生活困难老年人提供免费或低收费服务。

内容供给方面，两部门提出继续办好「重温经典」频道和点播专区，增加老年题材精品节目、剧集与纪录片。通知同时要求坚决整治违规医药广告播出，并保留适合老年人的传统服务模式。
title_en: China Moves to Simplify TV Access and Ban Deceptive Medical Ads for Seniors
content_en:
Chinese authorities have launched a joint initiative to make television viewing easier for elderly citizens while eliminating deceptive medical advertisements targeting older audiences.

In a circular issued by the National Radio and Television Administration and the Ministry of Civil Affairs, regulators called for the widespread adoption of simplified hardware, including single-remote control systems, integrated smart TVs, and plug-in mini set-top boxes. The measures aim to streamline interface navigation, clear up channel numbering, and refine on-demand viewing features. Local governments are also encouraged to provide subsidized or free cable services to low-income seniors.

On the content side, officials plan to enrich television offerings with more senior-focused dramas, documentaries, and classic rerun channels. Crucially, the notice mandates a strict crackdown on illegal medical advertising while preserving essential traditional service options for elderly viewers.

title_zh: 《复仇者联盟 5》上海影迷盛典定于 12 月 10 日，唐尼等主创来华
content_zh:
迪士尼宣布，《复仇者联盟 5》影迷盛典将于 12 月 10 日 19:00 在上海浦发银行东方体育中心举行。

活动嘉宾包括小罗伯特·唐尼、克里斯·埃文斯、克里斯·海姆斯沃斯，以及漫威影业总裁凯文·费奇。三位演员此前分别因钢铁侠、美国队长和雷神等角色为观众熟悉。

本次影迷盛典面向影迷免费开放，通过线上预约及抢票获取入场资格。官方活动海报也已公布时间、场地与四位嘉宾名单。
title_en: Disney Announces 'Avengers 5' Shanghai Fan Event Featuring Robert Downey Jr. and Star-Studded Cast
content_en:
Disney has announced a massive fan event for *Avengers 5*, scheduled to take place on December 10 at the SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai.

The star-studded lineup features Marvel Studios President Kevin Feige alongside franchise icons Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, and Chris Hemsworth, who famously portrayed Iron Man, Captain America, and Thor.

Admission to the event will be free for fans, who can secure tickets through an online reservation system. Disney has officially released event posters confirming the date, venue, and celebrity guests.

title_zh: Netflix《三体》第二季首曝预告，明年 1 月 14 日上线
content_zh:
Netflix 剧版《三体》第二季公开首支预告，将于 2027 年 1 月 14 日上线。预告从三体人向地球发出信息开始，宣称将派来使者；利亚姆·坎宁安饰演的托马斯·维德则警告，对方的目的并非谈判。

据 TheWrap 报道，新一季围绕人类如何应对外星入侵、为生存做准备展开。预告展示了恐慌、抵抗与人们彼此寻求慰藉的场面，冲突从第一季发现威胁进入备战阶段。

剧集由戴维·贝尼奥夫、D.B. 威斯与亚历山大·吴共同改编，第一季于 2024 年 3 月上线。Netflix 此前已宣布续订第二季和作为最终季的第三季，三季整体改编刘慈欣的《地球往事》三部曲。
title_en: Netflix Drops First Teaser for '3 Body Problem' Season 2, Setting Premiere Date
content_en:
Netflix has released the first teaser trailer for Season 2 of its sci-fi series *3 Body Problem*, announcing a premiere date of January 14, 2027. The trailer opens with the Trisularians sending a message to Earth declaring the arrival of an emissary, while Thomas Wade, played by Liam Cunningham, warns that the alien force has no intention of negotiating.

Adapted by showrunners David Benioff, D.B. Weiss, and Alexander Woo, the upcoming season shifts from discovering the alien threat to full-scale preparation for invasion and human survival. The preview highlights growing panic, organized resistance, and humanity seeking solidarity amid the crisis.

The series adapts Liu Cixin's celebrated *Remembrance of Earth's Past* book trilogy. Netflix previously renewed the show for both a second season and a third season, which will serve as the final chapter of the saga.

title_zh: 《Call Me Bae》第二季定档 12 月 17 日，预告同步公开
content_zh:
Prime Video 宣布，印度喜剧爱情剧《Call Me Bae》第二季将于 12 月 17 日上线，并发布先导预告。阿南尼娅·潘迪回归饰演富有的社交媒体人物 Bella Chowdhary，剧集继续围绕她的事业、感情与女性友谊展开。

据 Deadline 报道，第二季共八集，由 Collin D’Cunha 执导、Ishita Moitra 创作，Dharmatic Entertainment 制作。施卢蒂·哈桑加入，Vir Das、Gurfateh Pirzada、Varun Sood 等回归出演。

新一季中，Bella 的事业逐渐上升，却在两位追求者之间面临选择；她与朋友遵守的「Behen Code」也将因新成员加入而发生变化。第一季曾进入 Prime Video 超过 50 个国家和地区的热门前十。
title_en: Prime Video Sets December 17 Premiere for 'Call Me Bae' Season 2, Drops Teaser
content_en:
Prime Video has officially announced the return of its hit Indian romantic comedy series, *Call Me Bae*. Season 2 is scheduled to premiere on December 17, alongside the release of its first teaser trailer. Ananya Panday reprises her role as wealthy heiress-turned-influencer Bella Chowdhary as the series continues to explore her career, love life, and female friendships.

Created by Ishita Moitra, directed by Collin D’Cunha, and produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, the eight-episode second season follows Bella as her career hits new heights. However, personal complications arise as she finds herself torn between two suitors, while her friend group's unwritten "Behen Code" is tested by new additions.

The upcoming season introduces Shruti Haasan to the cast, joining returning fan favorites including Vir Das, Gurfateh Pirzada, and Varun Sood. The show's renewal follows a standout first season, which breached the Top 10 charts on Prime Video in over 50 countries and regions.
